cancellation_final_database_tla:
[ bindings |-> (SessionA :> WorkerIdentity @@ SessionB :> NoValue),
  attempts |->
      ( AttemptOne :>
            [ started |-> TRUE,
              holder |-> SessionA,
              generation |-> 1,
              cancelled |-> TRUE,
              ended |-> TRUE ] @@
        AttemptTwo :>
            [ started |-> FALSE,
              holder |-> NoValue,
              generation |-> 0,
              cancelled |-> FALSE,
              ended |-> FALSE ] ),
  events |->
      << [ holder |-> NoValue,
           attempt |-> AttemptOne,
           gen |-> 1,
           principal |-> WorkerIdentity,
           session |-> SessionA,
           key |-> NoValue,
           kind |-> "start",
           claimGen |-> 0,
           bound |-> TRUE,
           permitted |-> TRUE ] >>,
  idem |->
      ( WorkerIdentity :>
            [ k1 |-> [attempt |-> NoValue, gen |-> 0, event |-> 0],
              k2 |-> [attempt |-> NoValue, gen |-> 0, event |-> 0] ] @@
        OtherIdentity :>
            [ k1 |-> [attempt |-> NoValue, gen |-> 0, event |-> 0],
              k2 |-> [attempt |-> NoValue, gen |-> 0, event |-> 0] ] ),
  member |-> TRUE,
  departed |-> FALSE,
  currentRound |-> TRUE,
  localAllowed |-> TRUE,
  sharedAllowed |-> TRUE,
  active |-> {WorkerIdentity, OtherIdentity} ]
